entries.text: It's a prayer candle, Mulder, not a birthday cake. Mm-hm. Heh. Prayers aren't meant to be sentiment. It's a conversation. You can do tt like a meditation. Or if your needs exceed your grasp... ...You can ask God to act on your behalf. But you don't believe in God. So you'd essentially be talking to yourself. I may not believe in God, but I believe in you.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cathedral Of The Sacraments - Day

entries.text: Therefore, I soeak to him through you. So It's a transitive property of equality. If A equals B and B equals C... ...Therefore A equals C. Reason and faith in harmony. Isn't that why we're so good together?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cathedral Of The Sacraments - Day

entries.text: Are we together? You know, I believed I could protect our son. And I failed. I believed that we could live together. And I fled. I gave up on that too. If only you had fled earlier.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cathedral Of The Sacraments - Day

entries.text: Do you know how many times I've envisioned that scenario... ...Where you left that basement office before I even needed glasses? You'd have your health...
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cathedral Of The Sacraments - Day

entries.text: .. Your dog...
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cathedral Of The Sacraments - Day

entries.text: ... Your sister.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cathedral Of The Sacraments - Day

entries.text: You'd be Kersh's boss at the FBI.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cathedral Of The Sacraments - Day

entries.text: You'd be married to some brain surgeon...
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cathedral Of The Sacraments - Day

entries.text: ...And have a bunch of kids that you wouldn't have to give up. Mulder, I don't begrudge you any of those things. That's not what I was talking about.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cathedral Of The Sacraments - Day

entries.text: What are you talking about, Scully? Because I don't know If any God is listening, but I am standing right here. And I'm listening. Right beside you. I'm all ears.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Int. Cathedral Of The Sacraments - Day

entries.text: That's my choice.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cathedral Of The Sacraments - Day

entries.text: [CHOIR SINGING [N LATIN]

entries.text: [WHISPERING [NDISTINCTLY]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: That's not my 4-year-old self looking for a miracle. That's my leap of faith forward. And I'd like to do it together.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Int. Cathedral Of The Sacraments - Day

entries.text: I've always wondered how this was gonna end.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
